purpose: Collect service requirements and provide an indicative estimate for sales follow-up.

field_settings.estimate_disclaimer: Estimate only; final scope and pricing require review.

conditional_logic: Show travel add-ons only when the selected enquiry category supports add-ons.
Show care-plan note when Service category is Accommodation.
confirmations: Show a clear next-step message and state that the estimate is provisional.
notifications: Send admin lead notification to sales with estimate, selected services, and Reply-To set to submitter email.
Send user autoresponder without exposing internal calculation notes.
feeds: Optional CRM feed after consent and add-on detection; keep selected fields only.

spam_settings.recommended: Use available non-intrusive spam protection and review false positives before adding friction.

accessibility_settings.labels: Visible labels required for all fields.
accessibility_settings.calculation_context: Explain that Estimated total is provisional and update errors clearly.

embedding_target: Draft quote page or landing page; validate only one instance per page.
data_retention_notes: Includes consent to be contacted. Retain only as long as needed for lead follow-up and quote audit.

test_data.boundary_case: No add-ons and maximum quantity if quantity is introduced

risks: Calculated estimate may be mistaken for final pricing.
Payment or tax handling is out of scope unless explicitly approved.
